set.body: PRD RA-1 and RA-6. Implement greenfield AoiSet[U,E] with frame identity, unique entity keys, and no implicit spatial-overlap convention. Spatial assignment is explicit and policy-indexed: exclusive/priority outputs partition represented exposure; multiple membership reports per-entity mass, visible union, pairwise overlap, and mass by multiplicity. Temporal Overlap remains separate. Supply accounting laws and mutants for duplication, dropped background, and incorrect overlap sums.
